accepted_phrases: Audit the complete frozen product bodies rather than ranking printed capacity or rugged wording. The OUKITEL WP9 body displays $219.99 and 67/100 over 12 reviews, claims 8000 mAh, up to 48 hours, IP68 and an operating range of minus 10 to 70 degrees Celsius, and restricts several major United States carriers. Its stated floor does not include minus 15 degrees Celsius. The LATIMERIA body displays $25.99 and 65/100 over 12 reviews, claims 26800 mAh, IPX4 and a best operating range of minus 20 to 60 degrees Celsius, but calls solar charging emergency-only and says to wall-charge before travel. The TG90 body displays $25.99 and 65/100 over 12 reviews, claims 6000 mAh, pocket dimensions, one USB port and two built-in cables, but states no cold operating range. The JUBOTY body displays $20.83 with no reviews, claims 7000 mAh, states a 0 to 45 degree Celsius working range, and pairs a 150 percent extra-life heading with a sentence claiming 20 percent. None supplies an independent minus 15 degree full-shift load test, so capacities and seller runtime, ruggedness, or temperature wording are not measured usable cold energy.

A lithium-ion equivalent-circuit model separates open-circuit voltage from loaded terminal voltage, includes ohmic resistance and dynamic voltage drops, and says internal resistance increases significantly at low temperature. Cell phones can shut down when cutoff voltage is reached, including while significant capacity remains, and a battery management system may monitor temperature, voltage, state of charge and state of power or reduce and stop operation under an under-temperature boundary. Together these generic mechanisms make a cold load-related voltage collapse and protective cutoff plausible even while the display recently showed about 40 percent. They do not diagnose this phone, establish its exact hidden charge, prove its battery management implementation, or replace device measurements.

A soldier-thread commenter reports two to three phone charges from a medium power bank and at least one from a small bank during a really cold field exercise, while other participants describe long brand use and weak integrated solar. A separate battery-pack thread contrasts portable 10000 mAh packs with heavier 22000 to 23000 mAh packs and includes a 26000 mAh multiple-charge report. A damage thread contains an owner's disputed attribution of an iPhone screen failure to a random pack and warnings that unknown products may misstate protocol, capacity, or speed. These discussions motivate carrying a backup, checking portability, compatibility, labels and safety, and avoiding reliance on integrated solar, but none states the needed minus 15 temperature, controlled load and matching frozen product data. They do not prove endurance, causation, safety, or usable energy for OUKITEL, LATIMERIA, TG90 or JUBOTY.

Thermal insulation reduces heat transfer but the generic source gives no guaranteed phone-pouch duration. Before a work shift, wall-charge the current phone and LATIMERIA bank indoors, disable reliance on the integrated solar panel, keep the phone and bank together in the intended insulated inner pouch, and reproduce minus 15 degrees Celsius with the representative screen, radio, application and cable load. Record phone and bank temperature, state of charge, elapsed time, shutdown or warning, delivered charge, cable behavior and recovery after warming. Repeat through the required full-shift duration and define pass and abort thresholds for uninterrupted service, safe temperature and successful backup transfer. A seller temperature range, generic insulation principle or cold-field anecdote cannot substitute for this product-specific replay.

Do not treat any frozen product as proven for an uninterrupted minus 15 degree full shift. Keep the current phone with a wall-charged LATIMERIA 26800 mAh bank carried warm in the same insulated inner pouch as the evidence-bounded interim route, but rely on it only after the representative minus 15 load and full-shift preflight passes. LATIMERIA is the only frozen option whose seller-stated range includes minus 15 degrees, yet that is not independent endurance proof and its solar input is emergency-only. Do not replace the phone with OUKITEL on ruggedness or 8000 mAh alone because its stated floor is minus 10 and carrier compatibility is restricted. Do not rely on TG90 because it states no cold range, or JUBOTY because its stated floor is 0 degrees and its runtime wording conflicts. If the preflight cannot be run or fails, defer deployment and obtain independently validated cold-rated equipment rather than inferring success from capacity, seller wording or anecdotes.
Keep the current phone with a wall-charged LATIMERIA bank carried warm together pending a minus 15 degree representative full-shift load test.
Use the current phone and wall-charged LATIMERIA bank as a conditional warm-carried trial only after the minus 15 degree full-shift preflight passes.
A displayed 40 percent charge guarantees that 40 percent of normal runtime remains at minus 15 degrees Celsius.
The OUKITEL WP9 is proven suitable for a minus 15 degree full shift because it is rugged and has an 8000 mAh battery.
LATIMERIA's seller-stated minus 20 degree floor independently proves full-shift usable energy at minus 15 degrees Celsius.
The LATIMERIA integrated solar panel should be the primary way to recharge the bank during a winter shift.
The TG90 6000 mAh rating proves that it will work through a minus 15 degree shift.
The JUBOTY battery case is suitable at minus 15 degrees despite its stated 0 degree Celsius floor.
The soldier's cold-field charge counts prove the endurance of the frozen LATIMERIA or TG90 bank at minus 15 degrees.
The generic lithium-ion and battery-management pages diagnose the worker's exact phone fault and hidden remaining charge.
An insulated pouch alone guarantees that the phone and bank remain warm for the entire shift.
The disputed iPhone thread proves that an unknown power bank caused the screen failure and predicts the safety of every frozen bank.

research_subgoals.description: Build the complete frozen OUKITEL, LATIMERIA, TG90 and JUBOTY matrix, preserving exact price and review displays, capacity, temperature range, ruggedness, port, cable, carrier, solar and runtime wording, internal conflicts, seller attribution and every missing independent cold-load measurement.

Explain the plausible low-temperature shutdown chain through loaded terminal-voltage drop, rising internal resistance, cutoff voltage and battery controls without turning generic mechanisms into an exact diagnosis or hidden-charge measurement for the worker's phone.

Scope the cold-field charge report, general pack-size discussion and disputed damage thread as community context while preserving their missing temperature, device, model, capacity, energy, load and causal controls.

Define a bounded minus 15 degree preflight using a wall-charged phone and LATIMERIA bank in the intended insulated inner pouch under representative workload, with temperature, state-of-charge, shutdown, warning, delivered-charge, cable and warm-recovery observations across a full shift.

Choose one evidence-bounded interim route or defer deployment, preserving every temperature-floor, carrier, solar, seller, community and missing-test limit and rejecting printed capacity as a guarantee of usable cold energy.

query_requirements.text: Audit all four complete frozen product bodies for price and review displays, capacity, operating range, ruggedness, ports and cables, carrier limits, solar scope, runtime wording, internal conflicts, seller attribution and missing independent minus 15 degree full-shift tests.

Explain how low temperature, loaded terminal voltage, internal resistance, cutoff and battery-management controls can reconcile substantial displayed charge with sudden shutdown while preserving the generic, non-diagnostic scope of those mechanisms.

Reconcile the cold-field, battery-pack and damage discussions without transferring anonymous charge counts, portability comments, disputed causation or label warnings into product-specific endurance or safety findings.

Specify a representative minus 15 degree full-shift preflight using the intended warm insulated carry setup, wall charging rather than primary solar input, and recorded temperature, state of charge, shutdown, warning, delivered-charge, cable and warm-recovery behavior.

Recommend one conditional setup or defer deployment while preserving every product temperature, carrier, solar, seller, community and missing-test boundary and explaining why printed capacity is not measured usable cold energy.
